messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Spanish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Spanish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
118 y verás a los que están contentos 119 en el fuego porque esperan venir 120 cuando sea a los bienaventurados.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | e | conjunction “and then” | y | and | OK | | vederai | future “you will see” | verás | you will see | OK | | color | demonstrative pronoun “those” | los | those | OK | | che (rel.) | relative pronoun “who/that” | que | who/that | OK | | son | copular verb “are” | están | are | OK | | contenti | adjective “contented” | contentos | contented | OK | | nel | preposition “in the” | en | in | OK | | foco | noun “fire” | fuego | fire | OK | | perché | causal conjunction “because” | porque | because | OK | | speran | verb “they hope” | esperan | they hope | OK | | di | infinitive marker “to” | — | — | **MISSING** | | venire | infinitive “come” | venir | to come | OK | | quando | temporal conjunction “whenever” | cuando | whenever | OK | | che (particle) | idiomatic particle in *quando che* (no lexical meaning) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sia | subjunctive “may be” | sea | may be | OK | | a | preposition “to” | a | to | OK | | le | feminine plural definite article “the” | los | the | OK | | beate | adjective “blessed” | bienaventurados | blessed | OK | | genti | noun “folk” | bienaventurados | folk (as part of “the blessed”) | OK |
---
### Items to Review - **MISSING:** *di* (the infinitive marker “to” is not expressed in Spanish; the infinitive appears without a separate preposition). - **UNNECESSARY:** *che* (the particle in *quando che* has no counterpart in Spanish and can be omitted).
No WRONG or GRAMMAR issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Spanish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Spanish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 118: - Original: y verás a los que están contentos - Issue: none (the infinitive marker “di” is not required in Spanish) - Corrected: no change
- Line 119: - Original: en el fuego porque esperan venir - Issue: missing comma after “fuego” (source has “nel foco,”) - Corrected: en el fuego, porque esperan venir
- Line 120: - Original: cuando sea a los bienaventurados. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
